assertions.name: reproduces_step18_quoted_required_and_kd_character
assertions.source: kappa on the RETIRED z=1 cell is 0.998397668719 against step 18's quoted 0.998399 (|d| = 1.331e-6), and the Kohno-Drinfeld character (q + 1/q)/2 = 1.00544843335 against its quoted 1.005448 (|d| = 4.334e-7). Same object, so what follows is about step 18's own quantity and not a near-relative.

assertions.name: step18_hypothesis_is_false_on_both_ruled_cells
assertions.source: correction_below_one_excludes_real_spectrum carries the hypothesis (hk : k < 1). It holds on the retired cell (k = 0.9983976687) and FAILS on both ruled ones (k = 1.759364624 at z_D order-zero, 1.200249434 on the dashboard cell). The Lean theorem is correct and untouched -- it is a conditional and was always stated as one; its PREMISE is what the base change falsified.

assertions.name: on_a_ruled_base_the_elliptic_branch_is_excluded_not_the_hyperbolic
assertions.source: cosh(a) >= 1 for every real a (sampled min over a in [-4, 4] is 1.0; proved in general by real_spectrum_character_ge_one) while |cos| <= 1 (Real.cos_le_one, via ladderN2_lt_of_one_le). On a base needing kappa > 1 the ELLIPTIC generator is the excluded one and the HYPERBOLIC one is not -- the reverse of route 5's current narrowing to det A > 0 / |q| = 1 / the Kashaev locus, which was derived from the retired premise.

assertions.name: the_substrate_kd_generator_is_hyperbolic_and_on_the_right_side_now
assertions.source: Kohno-Drinfeld scale-fixing gives hbar = 2 ln q, so det A = -(ln q)^2 = -0.01088698592 < 0 -- hyperbolic at the real q_0, which step 18 recorded as the defect. With kappa > 1 it is no longer a defect: the character 1.00544843335 is on the SAME side of 1 as the requirement. Right side, wrong size -- see the next check.

assertions.name: the_kd_character_is_on_the_right_side_but_the_wrong_size
assertions.source: cosh(ln q_0) = 1.00544843335 against 1.75936462427 required at z_D order-zero. Non-exclusion is not a derivation: route 5 goes from a STRUCTURAL obstruction back to a QUANTITATIVE gap, which stays open. Recorded as a quantity to check against; no search was run for a construction that produces it.

assertions.name: the_11x_and_139x_figures_are_one_gap_in_two_coordinates
assertions.source: a_req/a_KD = 11.16826965 and (kappa-1)/(KD-1) = 139.3730225 are the SAME gap at the same base, in the generator eigenvalue and in the character excess. A sibling branch recorded 139x as a correction of 11.2x; it is a change of coordinate, not a correction, and neither figure is wrong. With c_k (magnifier 1/u^2 = 13784.8735) and (1 - F) this arc has five coordinates for one deviation.

description: Route 5's step-18 obstruction (a real-spectrum holonomy has character cosh(a) >= 1, so it cannot supply a correction below 1) carries the explicit hypothesis kappa < 1. That hypothesis holds on the RETIRED z = 1 cell (kappa = 0.9983977, reproducing step 18's quoted 0.998399) and is FALSE on both cells of the base the owner ruled on 2026-09-08: kappa = 1.7593646 at the z_D order-zero E_0 and 1.2002494 on the dashboard's scored nuc11 cell. The Lean theorem correction_below_one_excludes_real_spectrum is correct and untouched -- it is a conditional; its PREMISE is what changed. Consequence: on a ruled base the two proved inequalities point the other way -- cosh >= 1 (real_spectrum_character_ge_one) and |cos| <= 1 (Real.cos_le_one, via ladderN2_lt_of_one_le) together exclude the ELLIPTIC generator and leave the HYPERBOLIC one, which is what the substrate's Kohno-Drinfeld generator already is at real q_0 (det A = -(ln q)^2 < 0). So the narrowing to det A > 0 / |q| = 1 / the Kashaev locus / the N = 111 question rests on a retired premise. This does NOT derive the correction: the KD character 1.0054484 is on the right side of 1 and the wrong size against 1.7593646, a scope-(a) gap that stays open.
invariants_cited: real_spectrum_character_ge_one (QOU/QBeta/HolonomySpectrumSignObstruction.lean, sorry-free) and Real.cos_le_one via ladderN2_lt_of_one_le (QOU/QBeta/LadderFactorBound.lean, sorry-free)

A sibling recorded 139x as a correction of 11.2x; it is a change of coordinate. Say which coordinate before quoting a factor in this arc.
scope: (b) for the reversal, citing two proved invariants; (a) for every number. Derives no alpha, selects no base -- that the ruled base makes the step-18 exclusion lapse is NOT a reason to prefer it (NO FITTING) -- and wires nothing.
